question: Ticket e95b5d93cff0 says 'meter carried into the log', but outline 11.4.4.1 reads "The stored answers are learning, so they live in the memory model: a tree the proxy holds by the librarian's delegation, asking "what did this request answer?". An answer is found by its exact request and carries no embedding (4.3.1.6). The meter (every call, its verdict and cost) is not learning: it is metrics (17.27). The inference ticket, a file in the logs tree on the 30 day clock, is only for debugging." (Outline 11.4.4.1 explicitly states 'The meter (every call, its verdict and cost) is not learning: it is metrics (17.27)'. Outline 4.3.2 and 17.27 distinguish between the transient logging tree (4.3.2) and metrics—permanent records (17.27.5: 'Rows are kept forever'). If 'the log' refers to the transient logging tree (as the outline uses the term), meter cannot simultaneously be in both metrics (permanent, outline spec) and the log (transient, ticket statement).). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
